dedupe_keys.name: simulated pmu data for transmission line parameter identification

description: Simulated PMU data for transmission line parameter identification is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Ancheng Xue. The dataset contains 500 sets of steady state PMU data from both ends of a 500kV, 300km transmission line. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
